projects.title: Tatka Bazar
projects.summary: A real-time multi-vendor e-commerce platform for the Bangladeshi market, integrated with local payment gateways and a live order tracking system.

caseStudy.problem: Local vendors needed a reliable digital storefront with payment methods Bangladeshi customers actually use — bKash, Nagad, and SSLCommerz — but existing platforms were either too expensive or poorly built.
caseStudy.approach: Designed a multi-vendor architecture with separate seller dashboards, real-time inventory management, and a streamlined checkout flow optimised for mobile-first Bangladeshi users.
caseStudy.solution: Built a full-stack platform with Next.js and Node.js, integrated three local payment gateways, implemented real-time order tracking via WebSockets, and deployed to a scalable infrastructure.
caseStudy.outcome: Launched with 15 vendors in Week 1. Payment success rate of 97%. Mobile conversion 3× above industry average for the region.

projects.title: CloudMetrics SaaS
projects.summary: A multi-tenant SaaS analytics dashboard with real-time data visualisation, team management, and usage-based billing via Stripe.

caseStudy.problem: The client needed a scalable SaaS platform that could handle multiple organisations with isolated data, role-based access, and billing that grew with usage.
caseStudy.approach: Designed a clean multi-tenant data model using PostgreSQL row-level security, built a component library from scratch, and integrated Stripe Billing with usage metering.
caseStudy.solution: Full-stack SaaS with Next.js App Router, Prisma ORM, role-based access control, real-time charts with Recharts, and an onboarding flow that gets users to their first insight in under 2 minutes.
caseStudy.outcome: Zero-to-launch in 8 weeks. First 50 paying customers within 30 days of launch. Churn rate under 5% in the first quarter.

projects.title: Apex Creative Agency
projects.summary: An award-worthy marketing site for a creative agency, built with cinematic scroll animations, a 3D hero scene, and sub-second load times.

caseStudy.problem: The agency's old site looked like a template and failed to communicate the premium quality of their work. Bounce rate was above 70%.
caseStudy.approach: Full design and development overhaul. Started with a visual direction workshop, then designed a site that felt like an Awwwards winner — with purpose-driven animation and performance as a first-class constraint.
caseStudy.solution: Next.js with Three.js hero, GSAP ScrollTrigger reveals, Framer Motion micro-interactions, and a Lighthouse score above 90.
caseStudy.outcome: Bounce rate dropped to 32%. Average session time increased by 4×. Inbound enquiry volume up 180% in the first month.
